name: Car combat on lab_kart (race phase 3, internal/game carcombat.go): alice in the Intern Buggy (car 1), bob in the Senior Racecar (car 2) 20 m ahead of her in her lane. Every car is fitted with its type's built-ins and a full boost tank (2.5 s). Alice holds Q (the car's layer: +carfront): her Linter Beam fires along her heading, one beam a tenth of a second, 5 HP off bob's car each; C (+carrear) drops her Breaking Changes spikes behind her (gear in the world); Shift (+boost) with no throttle held drives her at full throttle, faster, while the tank drains a second a second, predicted in sync every tick (the tank is shared state)
